183:t_109:1.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Bring it on! I'll drill it into you until you're sick of it... that Earth has me, $$流竜馬$$, defending it!」

183:t_110:0.en:
$$セツコ$$
(There have to be enemies in the $$サイデリアル$$ who are even stronger than $$バルビエル$$...)

183:t_110:1.en:
$$セツコ$$
(But I'll win... If any more sorrow spreads through this world, someday there'll be no undoing it...!)

183:t_110:2.en:
$$セツコ$$
(Chief, $$トビー$$... I will fight. With our pride... this $$バルゴラ・グローリー$$...!)

183:t_111:0.en:
$$レド$$
「This is not within the area of operations of the $$人類銀河同盟$$...」

183:t_111:1.en:
$$レド$$
「But right now, I'm a member of $c. Let's fulfill that mission, $$チェインバー#robot$$.」

183:t_111:2.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「Acknowledged. This unit also hopes to respect your judgment and achieve the greatest possible results in combat.」

183:t_112:0.en:
$$ガロード$$
「Wait for me, $$ティファ$$! I'll take care of these guys in no time!」

183:t_112:1.en:
$$ガロード$$
「Let's go, you guys! Anyone who'd make $$ティファ$$ sad, I'll take them out myself!」

183:t_113:0.en:
$$ロラン$$
($$ディアナ$$... I'll use the power of the $$ホワイトドール$$ you entrusted to me for what is right.)

183:t_113:1.en:
$$ロラン$$
(And Miss $$ソシエ$$... I will definitely come back to you. After I've put an end to all the fighting...!)

183:t_114:0.en:
$$勝平$$
「No matter how many of you attack, don't think you can beat the mighty $$勝平$$ and $$ザンボット３$$!」

183:t_114:2.en:
$$恵子$$
「If you don't calm down, you're going to get hit someday!」

183:t_114:3.en:
$$勝平$$
「Shut up! If we're losing in spirit, there's no way we can win!」

183:t_114:4.en:
$$勝平$$
「Grandpa, Dad, Big Bro $$一太郎$$! Me, $$宇宙太$$, and $$恵子$$ will fight to the end, representing the $$神ファミリー$$!」

183:t_115:0.en:
$$ノノ$$
「B-Big Sis! Enemies are coming! They're fast! They look strong!」

183:t_115:1.en:
$$ラルク$$
「I can see that for myself. If you're scared, go scrub the $$クォーター$$'s bath or something.」

183:t_115:2.en:
$$ノノ$$
「N-No, $$ノノ$$ will do it too! Because...!」

183:t_115:3.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Because $$ノノリリ$$ also risked her life fighting to protect Earth!」

183:t_115:4.en:
$$ラルク$$
「So that's $$ノノリリ$$, the one you admire... I don't know who she is, but she sounds like a very upstanding champion of justice.」

183:t_115:5.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Aren't you a champion of justice, Big Sis?」

183:t_115:6.en:
$$ラルク$$
「...If enemies come, I fight. That's the job of us, $$フラタニティ$$.」

183:t_115:7.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Yes! $$ノノ$$ will do her very best as a trainee member too!」

183:t_115:8.en:
$$ラルク$$
「Yeah, yeah. Just don't get in our way.」

183:t_116:1.en:
$$ランド$$
「Stop with the limp cheering, like always!」

183:t_116:3.en:
$$ランド$$
「Quit joking. I'm $$ザ・ヒート$$... I'm always fired up and raring to go!」

183:t_116:4.en:
$$メール$$
「Yeah! $$ガンレオン$$ will answer with Magna Mode too!」

183:t_116:5.en:
$$ランド$$
「All right, here we go! $$ビーター・サービス$$, open for business!」

183:t_116:6.en:
$$メール$$
「Though our real job is repairs!」
